outcome: International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire Short Form (ICIQ-SF) score
cohort: Women with term singleton pregnancy and fetus in cephalic presentation
finding: Epidural analgesia did not affect the onset of postpartum urinary incontinence at 8 weeks postpartum, regardless of the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia did not affect the onset of PUI at 8 weeks postpartum, regardless of whether the women had a vaginal delivery (with or without episiotomy) or an emergency cesarean section.
